definitions.order: Tasks not done first, then by due_date (earliest first, no due date last), then newest first.
definitions.overdue: task_status is not done and due_date is before today (UTC).
definitions.scope: Uploads and analyses are selected by owner (user_id) and by their own created_at within [date_from, date_to] (UTC, both days inclusive). Reviews are those of the selected analyses; sites and environmental coverage are the selected uploads.
definitions.task: A field-log entry of kind task on an analysis in scope (created in the Researcher Mode field log).
